exercises.prompt: What is the triliteral root and semantic force of اِسْتَغْفَرَ?
choices: Root غ-ف-ر — Form X ('to seek forgiveness')
exercises.answer: Root غ-ف-ر — Form X ('to seek forgiveness')
exercises.explanation: Form X (اِسْتَفْعَلَ) prefixes اِسْتَـ to express seeking or requesting the root action (غ-ف-ر 'forgive' → 'seek forgiveness').

feedback.rule: Form X (اِسْتَفْعَلَ) = seeking, requesting, or deeming.

exercises.prompt: True or False: Form IX (اِفْعَلَّ, e.g., اِحْمَرَّ) is primarily used for colors and physical traits.
exercises.explanation: True. Form IX is specialized for colors and fixed physical characteristics.

feedback.rule: Form IX = colors and bodily traits.
